witnesses.Susa-I: Scheil's Fragment I from Susa (Old Babylonian duplicate of the code, Délégation en Perse X, p. 81 ff.), as transliterated in Kohler & Ungnad, Hammurabi's Gesetz II (1909) pp. 33–35; signs in Ungnad, Keilschrifttexte der Gesetze Hammurapis (1909)
witnesses.Susa-II: Scheil's Fragment II from Susa (Old Babylonian duplicate, Délégation en Perse X, p. 83), col. I, as in Kohler & Ungnad II pp. 35–36
witnesses.Rm277: Kuyunjik tablet Rm. 277 (Assyrian copy of the code), cols. I and III, as in Kohler & Ungnad II pp. 33–35
witnesses.DT81: Kuyunjik tablet DT 81 (Assyrian copy of the code), col. II and col. III, as in Kohler & Ungnad II pp. 35–36

notation: Notation: Kohler–Ungnad 1909 / Cuq 1918 syllabic transliteration, q for their ḳ, plain š/ṣ/ṭ/ḫ. [ ] = broken or restored by the editor and NOT adopted as signs (the drafter reads the autograph/plate); (?) = the editor's doubt; ⟨ ⟩ = signs of that line taken from a different tablet than the line's witness (the Assyrian copy named in the unit's note), as Kohler–Ungnad print them in italics; ga = the GA sign read qa.

units.ref: Susa-I col. II = stele col. XVII 2–24 (the old-Babylonian copy; Kohler–Ungnad p. 34)
Rm. 277 col. I = stele col. XVII 25–28 (Assyrian copy; the Susa tablet is broken here; Kohler–Ungnad p. 34, italic)
Rm. 277 col. I = stele col. XVII 29–32 (only the opening of the law survives; Kohler–Ungnad p. 34, italic)
Susa-I col. II end / col. III: the rest of this law and the laws up to XVIII 3 (Ungnad: 'Hier einzuschieben Col. III von Fragment I, ergänzt durch Col. II von DT 81') — not given by Kohler–Ungnad
Susa-I col. III = stele col. XVIII 3 (only the end of one line: [. . i-na]-di-[iš]-šum 'they will give him'; Kohler–Ungnad p. 34, 'cca. 70')
Susa-I col. III, completed from DT 81 col. II = stele col. XVIII 4–17 (⟨ ⟩ = DT 81; Kohler–Ungnad p. 35, 'cca. 71')
Susa-I col. III = stele col. XVIII 18–24 (broken; Kohler–Ungnad p. 35, 'cca. 72'; the restorations in his right-hand column are conjectural)
stele col. XVIII 25–34 (about ten lines between §cca. 72 and §cca. 73: not given by Kohler–Ungnad — 'kleine Lücke')
Rm. 277 col. III = stele col. XVIII 35–40 (Assyrian copy; italic in Kohler–Ungnad p. 35, 'cca. 73'; the law is only a few word-beginnings)
Rm. 277 col. III = stele col. XVIII 41–42 (two broken line-beginnings; Kohler–Ungnad p. 35, 'cca. 74')
stele col. XVIII 43–49 (a gap before Fragment II; Kohler–Ungnad: 'Es folgt eine Lücke')
Susa-II col. I = stele col. XVIII 50–63 (Scheil's Fragment II; Kohler–Ungnad p. 35–36, 'cca. 76'; speech: '… you have crossed over … from your house … to the owner of the field')

DT 81 col. III = stele col. XIX 25–42 (Assyrian copy, entirely restored in italics by Kohler–Ungnad p. 36, 'cca. 78' — the Old Babylonian copy is lost here; he cautions that the restorations are partly doubtful)

gaps: The whole of stele cols. XVII 33 – XXIII (about seven columns in all, ≈ §§ 67–99): the stele is erased here and Kohler–Ungnad's duplicates cover only the stretches printed above.
Stele col. XVIII 3, 25–34, 43–49: lines between the surviving pieces; not given in the edition.

Between §cca. 74 and §cca. 76 and between §cca. 76 and §cca. 78 (Ungnad: 'Es folgt eine Lücke' / 'Nach einer Lücke folgt Col. III von DT 81'): lost; no law numbers are assigned. §75 and §77 are therefore not represented.
Susa Fragment II, col. II: only a few line-beginnings survive (bît[ . . . ], i[ . . . ], a[ . . . ], kaspum[ . . . ], ga[ . . . ], ša(?)[ . . . ]) — too little to form a unit.
K 8321 (Meissner, Beiträge zur Assyriologie III 521): a fragment of doubtful place (words as ù tar-ru[…], ANŠU.EDIN.NA = parûm, muzaîrum…, tamkarum, alpum…) — not placed, not used.
Line numbers and the order of the pieces are Ungnad's; the 'cca.' law numbers are his approximations.
